content.query:
USER_ID='ESDOQUESA' (UPDATED) .
USER_ID='JSDOLORITO' (DELETED) . 
USER_ID='MLSAMANIEGO' (UNCHANGED) .
USER_ID='9999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select USER_ID USER_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT USER_ID USER_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_TRURM WHERE USER_ID='ESDOQUESA'
UNION ALL
SELECT USER_ID USER_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_TRURM WHERE USER_ID='JSDOLORITO'
UNION ALL
SELECT USER_ID USER_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_TRURM WHERE USER_ID='MLSAMANIEGO'
UNION ALL
SELECT USER_ID USER_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_TRURM WHERE USER_ID='9999' ) temp order by USER_ID, SCD_START_DATE
